1) Location
- What city are you in, and which zoo are you planning to visit?

2) Date and time
- Do you already have a specific date in mind, or just a general timeframe (e.g., “sometime in October, on a Friday”)?
- Roughly what start/end time do you want for the trip?

3) Students and adults
- How many students are going, and what grade/age?
- How many chaperones/teachers will be with them?

4) Logistics
- How will you get there (school buses, public transit, parent drivers)?
- Do you have any budget constraints (tickets, buses, lunch)?

5) Scheduling help
- Do you want me to help you plan only (checklist, timeline, emails to parents), or also set this up as a calendar event on your calendar?

Reply with what you know so far (even if some details are still undecided), and I’ll shape it into a concrete plan and next steps.
</action>
